name: Brali practical knowledge ontology
description: A semantic layer over the legacy Growth Zone catalog. Domains describe where a need belongs, Topics describe the problem or skill, Methods describe structured approaches, and Lenses describe transferable ways of thinking borrowed from other disciplines.

terminology.domain: Broad area of practical life or work.
terminology.topic: Concrete problem, capability, or outcome people can work on.
terminology.method: Named structured approach that may be used across multiple topics.
terminology.lens: Transferable way of thinking borrowed from a discipline, profession, philosophy, or strategic tradition.
terminology.protocol: Executable sequence or personal experiment built from one or more hacks.
terminology.legacy_life_area: Compatibility navigation from the original Brali taxonomy. New records should use Domain.
terminology.legacy_growth_zone: Compatibility collection and stable URL from the original Brali taxonomy. It may map to a Topic, Method, or Lens.

domains.title: Focus & Action
domains.description: Turn intentions into attention, decisions, plans, habits, and reliable follow-through.

domains.title: Mind & Resilience
domains.description: Work with stress, emotions, fear, mood, perspective, and psychological flexibility.

domains.title: Health & Energy
domains.description: Support sleep, movement, physical wellbeing, recovery, and everyday energy without turning general guidance into treatment.

domains.title: Learning & Thinking
domains.description: Build memory, skills, reasoning, problem-solving, data literacy, and metacognition.

domains.title: Communication & Relationships
domains.description: Listen, speak clearly, handle difficult conversations, repair conflict, and build stronger relationships.

domains.title: Creativity & Expression
domains.description: Generate, develop, communicate, and improve ideas through creative practice and writing.

domains.title: Work & Money
domains.description: Improve work systems, career choices, personal finance, strategy, negotiation, and positioning.

domains.title: Environment & Digital Life
domains.description: Shape digital attention, information flows, physical spaces, workspaces, and technology use so the environment supports rather than fights the user.

topics.title: Attention & Focus
topics.description: Protect attention, reduce unnecessary switching, and sustain useful focus.

topics.title: Task Initiation

topics.title: Planning & Prioritization
topics.description: Choose what matters, order work, and make the next action clear.

topics.title: Goals
topics.description: Define meaningful outcomes and connect them to controllable actions.

topics.title: Habits & Consistency
topics.description: Make useful behavior easier to repeat and review over time.

topics.title: Decision Making
topics.description: Structure choices under uncertainty and update decisions when evidence changes.

topics.title: Error Prevention
topics.description: Prevent avoidable mistakes with checks, constraints, and review points.

topics.title: Stress Regulation
topics.description: Use low-risk practices to respond to everyday stress and regain workable perspective.

topics.title: Emotion Regulation
topics.description: Notice, understand, and respond to emotions without promising emotional control on demand.

topics.title: Fear & Confidence
topics.description: Approach manageable challenges, understand fear responses, and build confidence gradually.

topics.title: Worry & Rumination
topics.description: Work with repetitive thinking and redirect attention toward useful action.

topics.title: Mood & Wellbeing
topics.description: General wellbeing practices for mood and daily functioning, kept separate from diagnosis or treatment.

topics.title: Psychological Flexibility
topics.description: Stay connected to values and useful action while making room for difficult internal experiences.

topics.title: Self-Awareness
topics.description: Notice patterns in thoughts, behavior, needs, triggers, and context.

topics.title: Everyday Health Basics
topics.description: General routines that support physical wellbeing without replacing professional care.

topics.title: Sleep & Circadian Rhythm
topics.description: Sleep timing, regularity, environment, and daily rhythms.

topics.title: Movement
topics.description: Reduce prolonged inactivity and add practical movement to daily life.

topics.title: Fitness & Strength
topics.description: Exercise, conditioning, strength, mobility, and sustainable physical practice.

topics.title: Recovery & Energy
topics.description: Manage effort, breaks, recovery, and everyday energy without pseudoscientific optimization claims.

topics.title: Nutrition
topics.description: General food and nutrition habits with clear safety and evidence boundaries.

topics.title: Cardiovascular Health
topics.description: General educational material about cardiovascular-health habits, not diagnosis or treatment.

topics.title: Memory
topics.description: Encoding, retrieval, consolidation, forgetting, and remembering what matters.

topics.title: Skill Learning
topics.description: Build capabilities through practice, feedback, transfer, and iteration.

topics.title: Language Learning
topics.description: Learn vocabulary, patterns, comprehension, production, and communicative skill.

topics.title: Critical Thinking
topics.description: Separate claims from evidence, compare explanations, and reason more carefully.

topics.title: Problem Solving
topics.description: Frame problems, generate options, test hypotheses, and learn from results.

topics.title: Metacognition
topics.description: Think about how you learn, reason, monitor confidence, and adjust strategy.

topics.title: Data Literacy
topics.description: Use data, measurement, uncertainty, and simple analysis to make better judgments.

topics.title: Cognitive Biases
topics.description: Recognize predictable reasoning shortcuts and design checks against them.

topics.title: Listening
topics.description: Understand another person accurately before assuming agreement or disagreement.

topics.title: Clear Communication
topics.description: Make messages easier to understand, act on, and correct.

topics.title: Difficult Conversations
topics.description: Prepare and handle high-friction conversations with clarity and boundaries.

topics.title: Conflict & Repair
topics.description: Repair misunderstandings, resolve workable conflict, and restore cooperation where possible.

topics.title: Relationships
topics.description: Build empathy, trust, reciprocity, boundaries, and shared routines.

topics.title: Social Confidence
topics.description: Use practical communication scripts and gradual practice in social situations.

topics.title: Idea Generation
topics.description: Produce more varied ideas before narrowing or judging them.

topics.title: Creative Problem Solving
topics.description: Combine reframing, constraints, analogy, and experimentation to solve problems differently.

topics.title: Writing
topics.description: Plan, draft, structure, and communicate in writing.

topics.title: Revision & Feedback
topics.description: Improve work through useful feedback, revision, and comparison against intent.

topics.title: Work Systems
topics.description: Organize recurring work, handoffs, checklists, meetings, and execution loops.

topics.title: Career
topics.description: Build evidence of capability, choose development moves, and navigate career transitions.

topics.title: Personal Finance
topics.description: General money habits, planning, and financial decision hygiene, not individualized financial advice.

topics.title: Strategy
topics.description: Choose where to play, what not to do, and how moves interact over time.

topics.title: Negotiation
topics.description: Prepare interests, alternatives, trade-offs, and communication for negotiated decisions.

topics.title: Marketing & Positioning
topics.description: Clarify audience, value, message, proof, and distribution without manipulative tactics.

topics.title: Digital Attention
topics.description: Reduce avoidable distraction from notifications, feeds, switching, and device defaults.

topics.title: Information Management
topics.description: Capture, retrieve, summarize, and maintain useful information without building a second job around the system.

topics.title: Environment Design
topics.description: Shape physical spaces for privacy, comfort, accessibility, useful routines, and lower everyday friction beyond the workspace alone.

topics.title: Workspace
topics.description: Shape physical and digital work environments to reduce friction and errors.

topics.title: Digital Wellbeing
topics.description: Use technology deliberately while protecting sleep, attention, relationships, and recovery.

methods.title: Implementation Intentions
methods.description: If-then planning that links a recognizable cue to a specific action.

methods.title: MCII / WOOP
methods.description: Mental contrasting with implementation intentions: desired future, obstacle, then an if-then plan.

methods.title: Retrieval Practice
methods.description: Practice recalling information instead of relying only on re-exposure; transfer claims must be kept outcome-specific.

methods.title: Spaced Practice
methods.description: Distribute learning opportunities across time rather than concentrating all exposure in one session.

methods.title: Interleaving
methods.description: Mix related problem types or categories when doing so supports discrimination and transfer.

methods.title: TRIZ
methods.description: Structured inventive problem-solving methods derived from patterns of technical innovation.

methods.title: Game Theory
methods.description: Model strategic choices where outcomes depend on the actions and incentives of multiple actors.

methods.title: CBT-derived
methods.description: Techniques inspired by cognitive behavioral therapy. Sensitive content requires source review and must not be presented as individualized therapy.

methods.title: ACT-derived
methods.description: Techniques inspired by Acceptance and Commitment Therapy. Sensitive content requires source review and clear boundaries.

methods.title: DBT-derived
methods.description: Techniques inspired by Dialectical Behavior Therapy. Sensitive content requires source review and clear boundaries.

methods.title: Exposure-derived
methods.description: Graded exposure concepts for fears and avoidance. Clinical or severe cases require professional guidance; public protocols must be conservative.

methods.title: Metacognitive Therapy-derived
methods.description: Techniques inspired by metacognitive therapy. Sensitive claims require direct evidence review.

methods.title: Psychodynamic-derived
methods.description: Reflection techniques inspired by psychodynamic traditions; avoid converting theory into unsupported causal claims.

methods.title: Cognitive Analytic Therapy-derived
methods.description: Pattern-mapping techniques inspired by cognitive analytic therapy; sensitive use requires careful review.

methods.title: Positive Psychotherapy-derived
methods.description: Strength- and resource-oriented practices inspired by positive psychotherapy; claims require review.

methods.title: Body-oriented Therapy-derived
methods.description: Body-awareness practices inspired by body-oriented therapy; avoid unsupported physiological or trauma-treatment claims.

methods.title: Ericksonian-derived
methods.description: Communication and reframing ideas inspired by Ericksonian traditions; therapeutic claims require review.

methods.title: Gestalt-derived
methods.description: Awareness and experiential practices inspired by Gestalt therapy; sensitive use requires review.

methods.title: NLP (legacy)
methods.description: Legacy Neuro-Linguistic Programming material retained for review. Do not imply scientific validation without direct high-quality evidence.

lenses.title: Stoicism
lenses.description: Use distinctions such as controllable action versus uncertain outcome as a philosophical lens, not as empirical proof.

lenses.title: Antifragility
lenses.description: Look for optionality, bounded downside, learning from variability, and systems that can improve through manageable stressors.

lenses.title: Quality Assurance
lenses.description: Borrow test cases, checklists, acceptance criteria, regression thinking, and defect prevention for everyday processes.

lenses.title: Architecture
lenses.description: Use boundaries, dependencies, interfaces, trade-offs, and system structure to reason about complex personal or work systems.

lenses.title: Detective
lenses.description: Separate observations from interpretations, build competing hypotheses, and look for disconfirming evidence.

lenses.title: Chef / Operations
lenses.description: Borrow mise en place, sequencing, preparation, timing, and dependency management from kitchen operations.

lenses.title: Chess
lenses.description: Think in candidate moves, consequences, tempo, constraints, and opponent responses without pretending life is a board game.

lenses.title: Classical Strategy
lenses.description: Use historical stratagems as prompts for option generation and perspective, not as universal social manipulation rules.

lenses.title: Fieldcraft
lenses.description: Practical heuristics learned from how experienced practitioners prepare, notice signals, and reduce friction in a domain.

lenses.title: Quantum (legacy analogy)
lenses.description: Legacy conceptual material retained for historical compatibility. Quantum mechanics must not be used as scientific evidence for self-help or cognition claims.
